resources.string: %1$s Uepeker kusu mosma an cinuyep a=ama wa an. ZIP ne a=ama kusu File > Export recovery copy a=eywanke yan. Kon rusuy yakun ZIP or wa canvas.png a=sanke wa, noka ne a=neire hine yayan saysu-kiru aeywankep a=eywanke yan.
Noka a=omare, pon noka te un a=raye yan

Android cinuyep-numke aeywankep ani noka 20 pakno a=omare easkay. Corpok tray or ta pon noka, cinuyep rehe, crop saysu newa cinuyep asire erin a=nukar, provider kor yak patek. Cinuyep rehe hene asire erin hene ari a=soyere easkay; soyere yakka tane a=anu noka uske a=kiru ka somo ki.

Pon noka a=kik hine a=numke. Crop image anak nea noka a=tuye; Batch crop anak a=numke noka or un pixel hene percent hene pes a=anu. Crop handle a=raye hene cipiskip a=nuye hene ki yan. Reset crop ari hoski pes a=hosipire. Crop anak moto cinuyep a=kiru ka somo ki, huskokatukar ka easkay.

Pon noka a=kisma hine a=raye, easkay yakun workspace or ta an noka a=raye wa, a=nukare pes or un anu. Half-sír noka anak e=anu kusu an uske sonno a=nukare. Sam ta a=kote yakun sapa uneno an; corpok ta a=kote yakun harkiso pes uneno an. Pon noka a=kik hine + target a=kik ka easkay. Hoskino noka anak origin or ta an. E=kor noka a=tuye yakun or un a=kote noka ka a=raye. Noka ukoetaye ka eaykap.

Same width newa Same height anak noka opitta kor yaykata aspect ratio a=epunkine kor, uneno saysu a=anu. Pixels, percent, Smallest hene Largest hene numke yan. Restore original sizes anak uneno saysu patek a=hosipire, crop a=ama.

Unplace anak a=numke noka patek tray un a=hosipire. Ios noka anak isam uske a=omasuy, anu wa an. Remove anak nea noka patek a=isamka. Undo/Redo ari sinna a=hosipire. A=anu noka a=raye yakun a=soyere; sat uske a=raye yakun view a=raye. Tu tek ani pinch hine zoom ki yan. Show all changes anak noka ukote opitta a=nukar pakno zoom ki, output saysu a=kiru ka somo ki.

Save PNG anak ukote noka PNG ne a=ama. Edit in Paint anak main editor un a=omante hine huskokatukar easkay replacement ne a=kar. Output anak memori budget kasu yakun pon output copy a=numke yan. Moto cinuyep a=kiru ka somo ki. Tane an assembly anak kikay or ta a=ama wa, suy e=ek yakun a=neire.

Toolbar corpok harkiso ta an arrow anak aeywankep a=komo hene a=sarare hene: kanto un arrow ari komo, corpok un arrow ari sarare. Portrait or ta tool strip anak toolbar corpok sampe un an; swipe wa mosma aeywankep a=nukar. Landscape or ta harkiso ta an. Brush topa or ta Pencil, Brush, Watercolor newa Airbrush an. Selection topa or ta rectangle newa free-form selection an. Insert topa or ta line, shape newa itak an. Category a=kik yakun portrait or ta strip corpok, landscape or ta sam ta, aeywankep newa iyanu a=sarare. Suy a=kik yakun a=komo; arrow ka hontomotuye. Category anak hoski a=eywanke aeywankep a=eramuan. Mosma iyanu newa edit control a=nukar kusu options panel a=scroll. Tan layout hoskino a=neire kor tu panel opitta a=sarare; ios e=numke katu a=eramuan. Landscape or ta kanto control anak sine row or ta an, cinuyep rehe tumu ta an; Menu anak File, Edit, View, Image, Colors newa Help a=neire, Android submenu arrow an.

FG/BG iro noka anak harkiso-corpok ta palette sam ta ramma an. Palette anak uneno row or ta sam un a=sarare. Arrow anak sam pes ta an: harkiso un yakun palette a=komo, sam un yakun a=sarare. Komo yakun extra swatch patek a=nuyna, iro noka a=raye ka somo ki. Iro box a=kik ka palette a=kiru. Swatch a=kik yakun kotca iro, a=kisma yakun oka iro. FG/BG anak Palette, Honeycomb newa Advanced a=neire. Advanced or ta spectrum, wheel, RGB, HSV, HSL newa 6-digit hex control an. Iyotta sam ta 4 cell anak tane eywanke iro a=ama; a=kik yakun kotca, a=kisma yakun oka iro. Yaykata iro hoski anak Pale Violet #5B67FF, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0 newa Copper #B87333. Yaykata swatch a=kisma wa a=kiru. Main editor anak opaque iro a=eywanke; transparent import anak tane an BG iro kasi a=anu. Moto cinuyep a=kiru ka somo ki.

Navigate anak husko magnifying-glass aeywankep ehos. Sine tek ani a=raye wa pan; tu tek ani pinch wa zoom newa pan. Navigate suy a=kik hene Draw again a=kik hene wa nuye or un hosipi. Draw aeywankep or ta ka tu tek navigation anak paint mark a=ama ka somo ki. Sam-corpok slider or ta 100% tumu line an. Zoom in/out button anak sine step ani 100% a=kasu yakun 100% ta hoskino sini; suy kik wa arpa. Sam an Fit button anak kampiso opitta view or un fit wa tumu ta anu. View or ta 100% newa pixel grid ka an.

Autosave anak edit irukaypo sini okake newa app wano e=soyene kor tane an draft a=ama. Status anak Draft saved hene autosave hayta hene a=nukare. Suy neire yakun draft, cinuyep rehe, tool iyanu, floating numkep newa naa a=okere ka somo geometry a=hosipire. Autosave anak ciyehe working draft ne a=ama. File or ta PNG, quality a=kiru easkay JPEG newa HEIC, lossless hene lossy hene JPEG XL, WebP newa AVIF an. Save and share anak Android sharing a=neire etoko cinuyep a=ama. Export anak e=numke uske un a=ama; cinuyep rehe or ta star an yakun export cinuyep okake a=ama ka somo ki sinna an. Autosave anak moto noka a=kasi-nuye ka somo ki.

Selection: rectangle hene free-form outline hene a=nuye. Tumu a=raye wa a=raye; square sike hene pes tumu handle hene a=raye wa resize; circle Rotate handle a=raye wa rotate. Lock proportions anak siurenkareno askay; aykapte yakun width newa height yaykata a=sarare easkay. Pes handle anak a=numke pes arahke patek resize. Free-form selection anak rotate newa autosave okake ka transform box or ta numkep katuhu a=epunkine. Saysu newa angle anak sidebar or ta a=nukare. Commit selection anak result sine huskokatukar easkay selection edit ne a=anu; autosave anak naa a=okere ka somo transform a=ama. Copy, Cut newa Crop to selection anak transform noka a=eywanke. Select all anak edit icon 2 row ta an, external keyboard ani Ctrl+A ka easkay. Cut/Copy newa Paste/Select all anak How to use corpok tu row ne an. Selection mask anak a=numke katuhu a=epunkine; document anak opaque ne an.

Kampiso pes: handle onnay un a=raye wa tuye, soy un a=raye wa pes a=sarare, oro wa Apply bounds a=kik. Asir uske anak BG iro; an pixel a=scaleka ka somo ki. Cancel newa Undo easkay. Resize image, Canvas size newa New image anak Pixels hene Percent hene a=eywanke, aspect lock ka easkay.

Curve: line a=nuye wa tu suy a=raye hine a=kemnu. Polygon: vertex a=kik, kes vertex a=kikkik hene Finish polygon a=eywanke hene ki. Close polygon a=aykapte yakun open segment ukokote a=nuye. Rounded rectangle: slider ani Radius (px) a=anu; radius anak takne pes half pakno. Text: kampiso a=kik, yaykata style ani a=nukare itokpa-noka a=numke, live cietokonukarpe a=eywanke. Saysu, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, alignment, line spacing newa BG text box an. Watercolor anak Brush topa or ta Brush newa Airbrush sam ta an; Strength a=kiru wa na riten stroke a=kar. Pencil, brush newa tool saysu slider 100 pixel pakno. Pencil anak 1 pixel wano, yaykata width a=eramuan. Cipiskip a=kik wa sonno value a=nuye. Heart, Star newa Arrow anak mosma shape kor outline/fill numke katu uneno an. View > Cursor drawing or ta askay/aykapte, cursor katuhu newa magnifier iyanu a=sarare. Cursor a=anu kusu a=raye, screen drawing button a=kik, oro wa pan wa nuye. Suy a=kik wa sini. Brush newa stroke iyanu anak Draw > Drawing or ta an. View > Magnified preview anak cursor hene nuye point hene a=porore wa a=nukare, magnification a=kiru easkay. Drawing settings or ta antialiasing newa stroke smoothing ka an. Mosma 10 itokpa-noka a=omare; Font licences or ta credit newa terms opitta an.

File > Load image anak Android picker ani kampiso a=kiru. Insert image into canvas anak noka floating selection ne a=omare. Corpok Catrobat sticker gallery anak online noka a=kore; download easkay noka a=kik hene a=kisma hene wa omare. Help > Image credits anak moto rinko newa licence notice a=ama. Kikay memori budget or ta easkay noka anak moto resolution ani load. Kon yakun resize-choice dialog or ta saysu, pixel cipiskip newa memori erampetek a=nukare, Pixels/Percent saysu newa aspect lock a=numke easkay. Moto cinuyep a=kiru ka somo ki.

File hene View > Image assembly hene anak noka 20 pakno easkay mosma workspace a=neire. Pon noka cinuyep rehe hene erin hene ari a=soyere. Sine noka crop hene poronno noka batch-crop hene ki. Same width / Same height anak aspect ratio a=epunkine kor load noka opitta uneno saysu a=anu. Pon noka hene a=anu noka hene a=raye wa sam/sapa uneno hene corpok/harkiso uneno hene snap. Unplace anak a=numke anu patek a=isamka wa uske a=omasuy. Show all changes anak view zoom patek. Save PNG anak assembly a=export; Edit in Paint anak huskokatukar easkay edit ne main editor un a=omante. App anak sine opaque noka editor a=eywanke. Image assembly anak mosma arrangement workspace ne an.
